The Entrez date bound follows the harness cutoff; the search has no publication-date `[dp]` limit.

Relative recall was 4/4 (100%) against the screened development records. These records helped build the strategy, so this is not independent validation or an estimate of sensitivity. No held-out validation or benchmark set was assembled.

I assumed a broad scope that includes psychological mechanisms and vulnerability to a later episode; those concepts are assessed during screening rather than required as a separate theory-word block. The final search was checked through three PRESS-structured internal critic rounds. The closing round accepted the required Entrez cutoff as a documented risk. This draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
